exposure: middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA PI)
outcome: neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission > 24 hours
cohort: 80 pregnant women with clinically suspected fetal growth restriction (FGR), singleton pregnancies, and gestational age over 30 weeks.
finding: The cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) significantly correlated with adverse perinatal outcomes and outperformed UA PI and MCA PI in predicting these outcomes.
